name: Talmon
title: Temple Gate Keeper
summary: Talmon was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper at the temple in Jerusalem. He is mentioned among the Levitical gatekeepers who returned from the Babylonian exile and resumed their service at the rebuilt temple. His family and descendants continued to serve as gatekeepers for several generations.

keyEvents.title: Listed among the gatekeepers who returned from exile
keyEvents.description: Talmon is mentioned among the Levitical gatekeepers who returned to Jerusalem from Babylon with Zerubbabel and the first group of returnees.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Nehemiah's list of returnees
keyEvents.description: In Nehemiah's list of those who returned from captivity, Talmon's descendants are listed among the temple gatekeepers.

keyEvents.title: Service as a gatekeeper at the storehouses
keyEvents.description: Talmon and his relatives served as gatekeepers at the storehouses by the gates, guarding the entrances to the temple during Nehemiah's time.

keyEvents.title: Listed in the genealogical records of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Talmon is mentioned in 1 Chronicles among the Levitical gatekeepers who were responsible for guarding the temple gates, a service that traced back to David's organization.

keyEvents.title: Guard at the threshold of God's house
keyEvents.description: Talmon and his brothers had the duty of keeping watch at the thresholds, an important service to protect the holiness of the sanctuary and control who was allowed entry.
